decision: The competitor (Atlassian Williams F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: The Mechanics of Car 55 left equipment on the grass area next to the grid after the 15 second signal.
offence: Breach of Article B5.5.5.a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative, reviewed video evidence and a marshal report. The team left a black plastic box on the grass area next to the grid and thereby did not take all of their equipment with them after the 15 second signal.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Start Procedure Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams F1 Team
